purpose: Trace each experiment-design element to the unresolved evidence problem while preserving the SQ09 rule that continuation-to-aqueous transfer precedes downstream fate.

design_rationale.reason: SQ10 found phase-specific rewetting plausibility for identified ammonium salts but no mapping from that chemistry to M_surface_NH4_non_aqueous_continuation.
design_rationale.claim_limit: Characterization of a tested residue does not automatically identify every ANIMO continuation state.

design_rationale.element: Stage A inert-surface primary transfer test
design_rationale.reason: The continuation-to-aqueous transfer must be tested with downstream receiver ambiguity minimized; otherwise post-rewetting loss can hide prior aqueous arrival.
design_rationale.claim_limit: An inert-surface result applies only to the tested residue and environment.

design_rationale.element: Stage B soil/mineral ordering and fate test
design_rationale.reason: SQ10 identified soil/mineral retention as credible downstream behavior. SQ09 nevertheless places sorption-after-arrival after the continuation-to-aqueous transfer, so Stage B must resolve ordering rather than treat any soil receiver as automatic refutation.
design_rationale.claim_limit: Soil/mineral uptake after demonstrated aqueous arrival is compatible with M1; only evidence for direct alternative transfer can refute the receiver ordering.

design_rationale.reason: SQ10 identified state-dependent atmospheric loss as credible ammoniacal-N fate. Such loss can occur after aqueous arrival, so it is required for mass reconstruction and ordering rather than being treated as automatic M1 failure.
design_rationale.claim_limit: Atmospheric loss after demonstrated aqueous arrival is compatible with the M1 transfer law.

design_rationale.element: earliest defensible and time-resolved post-rewetting aqueous NH4-N
design_rationale.reason: A terminal sample cannot distinguish complete early transfer followed by downstream fate from finite-rate release or direct alternative transfer.
design_rationale.claim_limit: The earliest sample defines experimental resolution, not literal zero-time behavior.

design_rationale.element: full N mass closure with uncertainty
design_rationale.reason: Candidate discrimination is invalid if missing N can be hidden in unmeasured sinks or analytical error.
design_rationale.claim_limit: Mass closure validates accounting quality, not the physical process law by itself.

design_rationale.reason: Background N in Stage B can confound source attribution and make receiver ordering impossible to infer.
design_rationale.claim_limit: Tracer use is a design recommendation, not inherited ANIMO theory.

design_rationale.element: no universal replicate count, time threshold or numerical epsilon
design_rationale.reason: SQ09/SQ10 provide no pilot variance, instrument response or uncertainty model from which universal values could be scientifically justified.
design_rationale.claim_limit: Executing studies must predeclare power, uncertainty, temporal resolution and acceptance criteria.
